title: Metrics Alerts and Action Groups
description: Set up metrics alerts and action groups to automatically respond to Azure resource issues.

data.text: Metrics alerts proactively notify you when a monitored metric crosses a threshold. They are evaluated every minute (or more frequently for signal-rich metrics) and can target any Azure resource that emits metrics.

terms.definition: A monitored metric or log query result that triggers an alert.
The value that, when crossed, activates the alert (static or dynamic).
A collection of notification actions (email, SMS, webhook, Logic App, etc.) that fire when an alert triggers.
An alert threshold computed by machine learning based on historical patterns.

data.title: Create a Metrics Alert (Azure CLI)
data.content: Alert when CPU exceeds 80% on a VM:
data.code:
az monitor metrics alert create \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --name high-cpu-alert \
  --scopes $(az vm show -g myResourceGroup -n myVM --query id -o tsv) \
  --condition "avg Percentage CPU > 80" \
  --description "CPU is too high" \
  --action /subscriptions/.../actionGroups/myActionGroup \
  --severity 2

data.title: Create an Action Group (Azure CLI)
data.content: Define who gets notified and how:
data.code:
az monitor action-group create \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --name myActionGroup \
  --short-name OnCall \
  --email-receiver send-to-admin emailAdmin@example.com \
  --sms-receiver send-to-oncall +1-555-0100 \
  --webhook-receiver send-to-slack https://hooks.slack.com/services/...

data.caption: Metrics alert and action group flow
data.definition:
graph TD
    VM[VM: CPU 85%] --> AM[Azure Monitor
    (evaluate alert)]
    AM --> AG[Action Group]
    AG --> E[Email to on-call]
    AG --> S[SMS to ops team]
    AG --> W[Webhook to Slack]
    AG --> LA[Logic App
    (auto-remediate)]

data.title: Alert Fatigue Is Real
data.text: Too many alerts cause teams to ignore them. Use dynamic thresholds, suppress duplicates, and escalate only truly urgent alerts to SMS or phone calls.

data.title: Set Up an Alert for Your App Service
data.description: Create an alert that notifies you when your app response time exceeds 2 seconds.
steps: Find the HttpResponseTime metric in Metrics Explorer.
Create a metric alert with a static threshold of 2000 ms.
Create an action group with your email address.
Link the action group to the alert.
Trigger the alert by running a load test against your app.
data.expectedOutcome: An active alert that fires and sends an email when response time exceeds the threshold.
